sources.title: Qwen3-Next: Towards Ultimate Training & Inference Efficiency
sources.snippet: Based on this new architecture, we train the Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base model — an 80-billion-parameter model that activates only 3 billion parameters during inference. This base model achieves performance comparable to (or even slightly better than) the dense Qwen3-32B model, while using less than 10% of its training cost (GPU hours). sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
